mapper.select: SELECT sl.id, sl.node_id, sl.line_type, sl.speaker, sl.content, sl.portrait_ref, sl.effect_ref, sl.required_choice_code, sl.order_index FROM story_line sl WHERE sl.node_id = #{nodeId} AND ( sl.required_choice_code IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM save_path sp INNER JOIN story_choice sc ON sc.id = sp.choice_id WHERE sp.save_id = #{saveId} AND sp.is_active = 1 AND sc.choice_code = sl.required_choice_code ) ) ORDER BY sl.order_index ASC, sl.id ASC
